# 比较页模板

用于横向比较与取舍。路径：`comparisons/<kebab-name>.md`

```markdown
---
title: 比较标题
created: YYYY-MM-DD
updated: YYYY-MM-DD
type: comparison
tags: [decision]
sources: []
confidence: medium
contested: false
contradictions: []
---
```
